headline: Schroder maintains overweight in Dyno Nobel on strong earnings and attractive valuation following business simplification.
reasoning: Dyno Nobel's overweight position contributed positively to May performance. The fund increased exposure earlier in the year and held positions through strong May results. Dyno Nobel has simplified its business aggressively, shedding its Fertiliser segment and concentrating purely on commercial explosives, blasting technology and mining services. Profits have benefited materially from tighter ammonium nitrate market conditions following over a decade of oversupply. Unlike many industrials which have re-rated, Dyno still trades on reasonable multiples.
quote: Both Dyno and Orica when reporting their results enjoyed strong performance through May, and Dyno in particular has looked to simplify its business aggressively through recent years, shedding its Fertiliser segment and concentrating purely on commercial explosives, blasting technology and mining services. Since demerging Dulux more than a decade ago, Orica has shared a similar focus, albeit a little broader. The big delta in profits for each from these activities has arisen after the commissioning of an AN plant in WA by Orica in partnership with Yara, which opened in 2016. This plant pushed the domestic market into over supply of AN and led to a decimation in product prices, and in turn profits. A decade on, growth in market volumes again sees the market as short, and pricing has again reasserted itself, reflecting a good market structure. Unlike many industrial stocks which have done well in recent times, both Dyno and Orica still trade on reasonable multiples.
episode_title: AUF Schroder Equity Opportunities WC FCM AUEN (May 2026)
